blind.description: A wooden apothecary cabinet or spice chest. The upper portion features two open shelves filled with various potion jars, bottles, and canisters in amber, green, and ceramic white finishes. The lower portion consists of a 5x5 grid of twenty-five small drawers, each fitted with a label holder and a brass pull knob. The unit features molded cornices at the top and base, with solid paneled sides and a plain flat wooden back. All surfaces are clean, solid, and fully textured with natural wood grain.
blind.from_above: A simple horizontal brown wooden rectangle representing the flat top panel of the cabinet.
blind.height_vs_figure: Stands around 4.5 ft tall (reaching the figure's chest/shoulder level), about 3.5 ft wide and roughly 1.8 ft deep.
